en: You want to know if the fish are\nbiting?
I can't catch anything good.\nNot one good POKéMON to be had!
I got a big haul!\nWanna go for it?
Heheh, MAGIKARP just don't make\nthe grade, do they?
I seem to only catch MAGIKARP!
The sea cleanses my body and soul!
The sea is great and all, but I\nlike the mountains, too.
